title: unified-rollouts: staged-shadow-canary-autorollback-workflow
author: Sara Nguyen
release_notes: Adds staged shadow + canary autorollback workflow with configurable probing and multi-metric thresholds; includes observability hooks and e2e stability guards.
body:
Motivation:
Production rollouts for model variants need safer, measurable automation: staged shadow probing, weighted canary ramps, and automatic rollback when composite metrics regress. This PR implements a first-class workflow that combines shadow probing with progressive canary ramping and multi-metric autorollback to reduce manual intervention and shorten safe rollout windows.

Summary:
- New orchestrator workflow: staged shadow -> probing -> weighted canary -> automatic rollback on policy violation.
- Multi-metric composite evaluator (latency P95, error rate, quality regression) with configurable thresholds per rollout.
- Observability: per-rollout metrics, tracing spans, and structured rollout events emitted to the Console.
- Safety guards: minimum probe sample sizes, cooldown windows, and circuit-breaker to stop further ramping after N failures.
- E2E and unit tests, and small infra change to rollout CRD schema (adds `probeConfig`, `compositePolicy`, `stabilityGuards`).

Implementation details:
- rollout/orchestrator: add StatefulWorkflow engine to coordinate shadow probes and weighted canary steps with callbacks into the autorollback engine.
- autorollback/engine: extend policy evaluation to accept composite metric expressions and multi-window evaluation.
- observability: emit `rollout.step.start`, `rollout.step.complete`, `rollout.policy.violation` events; wire into existing tracing and metrics exporters.
- api: extend rollout CRD and API surface; add validation for new fields in server side.

Testing and CI:
- Added end-to-end test that runs a staged shadow->canary scenario against the perf-canary harness with synthetic regressions injected to trigger rollback.
- Unit tests for composite policy evaluator and cooldown logic.
- Initial CI run failed due to a flakey probe timing test; fixed by adding deterministic clock injection and retried. Final CI status: all checks passed.

Rollout plan:
- Feature gate behind `unifiedRollouts.stagedShadowAuthRollout` (off by default).
- Canary rollout tested in staging for 48 hours with traffic shaping.
- Documentation update to rollout runbook and Console dashboards shipped in a follow-up docs PR.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-3421)
- [x] Unit + e2e tests
- [x] Metrics emitted and dashboard placeholders
- [x] Feature-gated
- [x] Backwards compatible API validation

Related: ENG-3421, ENG-3498, SUP-1287.

Commits summary:
- feat(rollout): add staged shadow workflow manager
- feat(autorollback): support composite metric policies and multi-window evaluation
- feat(observability): emit rollout lifecycle events and metrics
- feat(api): extend rollout CRD schema and validation
- test: add e2e for staged shadow + autorollback
- fix(test): deterministic clock injection for probe timing tests

Changed files (high-level):
- src/rollout/orchestrator/staged_shadow_workflow.go
- src/rollout/autorollback/engine.go
- src/rollout/api/rollout_crd_v2.go
- src/observability/rollout_events.go
- tests/e2e/staged_shadow_canary_test.go
- docs/runbooks/rollouts.md (placeholder updates)

review_comments: Marta Lopez: Nice work — can you clarify the cooldown semantics? If a rollback happens during a weighted ramp, do we stop and revert immediately or wait for cooldown?
Sara Nguyen: Reply: We stop and immediately revert to the last healthy variant; cooldown prevents immediate re-ramp for 10 minutes by default (configurable via stabilityGuards.cooldownWindow).
David Kim: Request changes: add an integration test for the circuit-breaker scenario where multiple transient failures should not trigger a permanent rollback unless sustained across windows.
Sara Nguyen: Reply: Added e2e case that injects transient failures and verifies circuit-breaker behaviour (tests/e2e/staged_shadow_canary_test.go).
Karthik Ramesh: Approve after CI green and docs PR linked.

notes_for_release: Feature gated by unifiedRollouts.stagedShadowAuthRollout. Enable in staging to run 48h validation. Monitor rollout.* metrics and rollout.policy.violation events.
discussion_thread: David Kim (2026-02-19): I ran through the design doc — looks solid. Only ask is to make sure policy thresholds are namespaced per customer in Dedicated deployments.
Sara Nguyen (2026-02-19): Good point — added namespacing in api validation layer and unit tests.
Marta Lopez (2026-02-20): Please ensure alerts are emitted when probe sample sizes are too small to evaluate policy. Otherwise autorollback may trigger on noisy signals.
Sara Nguyen (2026-02-21): Added sampleSize check and 'insufficient-samples' alert label on rollout.policy.violation events.
